nodes.description: Public string state variable holding the token name 'Delive'.
Public string state variable holding the token symbol 'DVE'.
Public uint8 state variable holding token decimals (5).
Public uint256 state variable holding the total token supply (6000000000000).
Mapping(address => uint) storing token balances of holders.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) storing ERC20 allowances.
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, total supply and minting the entire supply to msg.sender.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction.
Returns the balance of a given token owner from the balances mapping.
Returns the remaining allowance for a spender over a token owner's funds.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Debits balances[msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
Debits balances[from], decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd.
Addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
Subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
Multiplication with post-hoc require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
Division with require(b > 0) zero-division guard.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] executed without SafeMath in totalSupply().
Raw multiplication a * b whose overflow detection depends on a division check performed after the fact.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the 'name' state variable.
Constructor writes the 'symbol' state variable.
Constructor writes the 'decimals' state variable.
Constructor writes the initial _totalSupply value.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Caller address determines which account receives the initial minted supply.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] to compute circulating supply.
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping.
allowance() reads the allowed mapping.
approve() writes the allowed mapping.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], granting allowance based solely on caller identity.
transfer() reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer() debits balances[msg.sender] without any authority check.
transferFrom() reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom() decrements the allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance entry.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spending account for the allowance deduction.
transfer() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transfer() calls safeSub to debit the sender.
transferFrom() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
transferFrom() calls safeSub twice, for the balance and for the allowance.
totalSupply() executes an unchecked subtraction instead of using SafeMath.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction.
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend of the unchecked subtraction, so its growth can underflow the result.
safeMul performs the raw multiplication a * b before validating it via division.
Factor a flows into the multiplication operation.
Factor b flows into the multiplication operation.
transfer amount is the subtrahend passed to safeSub for the sender debit.
transferFrom amount is the subtrahend passed to safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the first dimension of allowed.
spender parameter indexes the second dimension of allowed.
spender parameter becomes the allowance grantee.
tokens parameter becomes the granted allowance amount.
to parameter becomes the credit target of transfer.
tokens parameter is the transferred amount.
from parameter is the debit target of transferFrom.
to parameter is the credit target of transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the transferred amount of transferFrom.

Result variable c written inside safeMul.
Dividend of safeDiv.
Divisor of safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
Result variable c written inside safeDiv.
